title: Tool Failure Event
description: Emitted when a tool execution fails, capturing friction patterns

tool.description: Name of the tool that failed (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, etc.)

file_path.description: File path involved in the failure, if applicable

file_context.description: Context about the file (e.g., test, config, source)

error_excerpt.description: Truncated error message from the failure

hints.description: Actionable hints for resolving the failure

is_subagent.description: Whether the failure occurred in a subagent

preceding_tool.description: Tool that executed immediately before this failure (Issue #18: friction root-cause chains)

preceding_result.description: Result of the preceding tool execution

preceding_file.description: File path the preceding tool operated on

chain_depth.description: Number of consecutive failures in this friction chain (0 = isolated failure)
